爱莎贝儿 148CM-L 粉肤 RAD014 樱空翼Sakura Tsubasa-驯服她
粉色长发散落在肩头，猫耳发箍歪歪地戴着。
三点式内衣紧贴着身体的每一道曲线，那野性的纹样在暗光里若隐若现，像某种危险的信号。
她趴着看你，舌尖慢慢舔过嘴唇。腰窝深陷，臀线高高翘起——不是讨好，是邀约。
朝你爬近一步，指尖按上你的腿，轻轻一划。眼神里全是“你敢不敢来”的挑衅。

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD014 Sakura Tsubasa-Tame Her
Long pink hair cascades over her shoulders, a cat-ear headband worn askew.
A three-piece lingerie clings to every curve of her body, its wild pattern peeking through the dim light like a signal of danger.
She crouches down, her tongue slowly licking her lips. Deep dimples at the waist, a high, rounded bottom—not ingratiating, but an invitation.
She crawls closer, her fingertips brushing against your leg. Her eyes are full of provocation, "Do you dare come?"
